title: Privacy Assessment Tool For Synthethic Data (PAT4SD)
summary: A capstone privacy-assessment framework that generates synthetic tabular data and evaluates its statistical quality and privacy risk before public release. It builds its synthesis and evaluation pipeline directly on SDV, calling CTGAN, TVAE, GaussianCopula and CopulaGAN synthesizers plus evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic to fit, sample, and score synthetic datasets.
